paper_title: Stepping Up Superradiance Constraints on Axions
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (inverse axion decay constant), plotted exactly as on the y-axis
notes: Black hole superradiance constraint on the axion decay constant f_a vs axion mass mu (main result Fig. 1, 95%/2sigma), derived from inferred spins of solar-mass black holes Cygnus X-1 and GRS 1915+105 including axion self-interactions and n<=5 states. This is an f_a-m_a plane bound => AxionMass. NOT a DM haloscope, so no local density. Numerical data points are ROUGH estimates inferred from the text (e.g. mu=2e-12 eV at alpha~0.33 for M=22.2 Msun); no numeric exclusion table is available in the provided content, so data quality is low. The excluded region spans roughly mu ~ few e-13 to ~1e-11 eV with f_a excluded up to ~2e17 GeV near the peak.
